patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Demandbase and Snov.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Demandbase only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and go-to-marke” rather than Snov.io's shape. Choose Snov.io only if your buying job matches “Budget SMB email finder, verifier, and cold email sequencer — Free/trial entry; Starter fr” rather than Demandbase's shape. Workflow advantage: Demandbase leans lead-management; Snov.io leans email-outreach. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Demandbase and Snov.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Demandbase is Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and go-to-market orchestration — custom-quote packaging.; Snov.io is Budget SMB email finder, verifier, and cold email sequencer — Free/trial entry; Starter from $39/mo..
- Company-size focus: Demandbase (mid-market, enterprise) vs Snov.io (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Demandbase-leaning lead-management vs Snov.io-leaning email-outreach.
- Researched limits: Demandbase — Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices; Snov.io — No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led.

Limitations — Demandbase: Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices; Enterprise ABM scope means substantial implementation and change-management cost; Snov.io: No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led; Contact database depth is lighter than ZoomInfo/Apollo-class breadth claims.

Poor-fit cases: Demandbase is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices · Snov.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led · Avoid Demandbase if you actually need Snov.io's motion (Budget SMB email finder, verifier, and cold email sequencer — Free/trial entry; )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
